replacements.old: - [ ] Derive capability lower bounds as well as ceilings.
replacements.new: - [x] Derive capability lower bounds as well as ceilings. — ✅ PR #907 / #906 BOUND-1: for a nonempty finite feasible class the uniform floor and ceiling are attained minima/maxima; a witnessed score lower-bounds the ceiling but is not thereby a class-wide floor. Class expansion can only lower the floor and raise the ceiling; empty classes return `NO_FEASIBLE_REALIZATION`. Exact 340-class and 3,840-inclusion censuses are zero-failure.

- [x] Derive capability interactions/synergies. — ✅ PR #907 / #906 INT-1: in one frozen contract/ecology/budget design, interaction is the exact mixed difference `s11-s10-s01+s00`; product-threshold capability has strict positive synergy iff neither baseline nor either single upgrade reaches the threshold but the joint upgrade does. A same-overlap/three-sign hostile retracts overlap-only inference; exact 81-table and 1,377-threshold censuses are zero-failure.

replacements.old: - [ ] Derive capability interference under shared budgets.
replacements.new: - [x] Derive capability interference under shared budgets. — ✅ PR #907 / #906 BUDGET-1: a mandatory charge `M` from hard shared budget `R` harms a target requiring `Q>0` iff `R>=Q` and `R-M<Q`; the budget-restoration twin removes the harm, while a score-preserving free-option superset cannot reduce the optimum. Exact 1,210-budget and 27-free-option censuses are zero-failure.
